mock.label: Illustration of the ArchLingmo desktop: a glass status bar, the Island showing a download and the dock with Lingmo icons
highlights.title: One system, from the glass to the apps
highlights.lead: Every part of ArchLingmo shares the same material, the same icons and the same motion. And it does more than it looks.
hl.glass.title: Lingmo Glass and the Island
hl.glass.text: Status bar, dock, Control Center and notifications in frosted glass, at four strengths. The Island shows music, timers, recordings and downloads without pulling you away. With "Reduce motion", everything calms down.
hl.ai.title: Assistant with flows, agents and voice
hl.ai.text: An AI that runs on your computer, with Ollama. It reads documents, notes and your calendar, and only changes things with your permission. On the way: multi-step flows, agents and voice.
hl.studio.title: Lingmo Studio
hl.studio.text: A DaVinci Resolve-style video editor. It turns a long video into Shorts and Reels cuts, with burned-in captions synced to the speech.
hl.boxes.title: Security boxes
hl.boxes.text: Windows programs, .deb and .rpm packages, AppImages and Android apps run in isolated boxes. You decide what each one can reach: files, network, camera and microphone.
hl.phone.title: Phone ↔ PC
hl.phone.text: Your phone's notifications, messages and files on your computer, with KDE Connect and LocalSend. Drag a file to the edge of the screen and drop it on a nearby device.
hl.continuity.title: One keyboard and mouse for all
hl.continuity.text: Move the pointer past the edge of the screen and it carries on to the computer next to it, with the same keyboard and clipboard, through Deskflow.
hl.apps.title: Lingmo apps
hl.apps.text: Mail with calendar, Notes, Photos, PDF Reader, Camera, Optimizer and more, with our own squircle icons and the same look in light and dark.
